author: UncondemnedSinner
body:
From the comments it seems you've already decided / taken Nidhogg.

I have to say that I have PD and Nidhogg, and I rely upon Nidhogg greatly... esp. in Boss Raids and Territory disputes.   I opted for Tamer as a specialization and thus NH does nearly 6k - 15k (when he gets a critical hit it's over 15K!!) damage almost every turn.   He's not very helpful against the holiday Boss Raid ... but against almost everything else he's a serious tank.
